newsitem.title: USA: Cost Plus May same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Cost Plus May same-store sales rise.

text.p: Cost Plus Inc said Thursday its same store sales for the four-week period ended May 31 increased 5.2 percent from the same four-week period in 1996.
Same store sales for the 17-week period ended May 31, 1997 increased 7.3 percent.
Total sales for the four-week period ended May 31, 1997 were $14.2 million, an 18.3 percent increase from $12.0 million, for the four-week period ended June 1, 1996.

Year-to-date, total sales for the seventeen-week period ended May 31, 1997 were $62.8 million, a 22.7 percent increase from $51.2 million, for the same period last year. As of May 31, 1997, the company operated 60 stores compared to 51 stores as of June 1, 1996.
